title: Family Four: Self-verifying vector and GPU retrieval substrate
subtitle: Same data, same result, verifiable at every step: every index proves it was built from the database it serves.

stats.label: properties bound into every index's attestation
checks: build, persist, publish and load
active generation per index at any moment
one GPU read per member vector, two computations from it

lede: Methods and Systems for a Self-Verifying Deterministic Vector Index and GPU Retrieval Substrate Materialized From a Relational System of Record. U.S. Provisional Patent Application No. 64/148,001 (patent pending). Embodied in the vector store of the Inference Fabric. Traditional vector pipelines create multiple copies of data, a source database, a vector store, index files, GPU memory, with no provable link between them. Data can drift, go stale or be corrupted, and nobody can prove what produced a result. Here the relational database is the only authority. Vectors are exported deterministically into memory-mapped shards that serve reads and carry references back to the database; they are serving representations, never another authoritative copy.
quote: Every boundary is identifiable, verifiable, or refused.
evidence: Vector search and ANN indexes: vectors exported deterministically from a relational database, the only authority, into memory-mapped shards; the same inputs, parameters, seed, format and implementation give a byte-identical index body.

Data provenance for retrieval: every index bound to its source data and build conditions by one binding hash over 8 properties, including shard identifiers, generations, row counts, content hashes and journal positions.

Fail-closed artifact pipelines: 4 checks at build, persist, publish and load, where a mismatch between disk and memory is a refusal, and at most 1 active generation per index so readers never see a torn set.

Embedding analytics and cluster metrics: each member vector read from GPU memory once to feed 2 computations, the similarity score and cluster-health metrics from mean and mean squared distance to the centroid.
GPU memory management: GPU residency keyed by data generation, evicting only the artifacts a change affected and never the whole cache.
author: Corey James
